name: manual_ce8ed8
claim: Before publishing an unpublished memory branch, rebuild the lesson log as the origin/main byte prefix plus only new rows. Do not republish a rewrite of existing rows or a false claim that an earlier commit was replaced.

decisions.notes: The second unpublished memory commit reserialized existing rows and said it replaced its parent, while that parent remained in history.

rationale: The second unpublished memory commit reserialized existing rows and said it replaced its parent, while that parent remained in history.
